Specification: This specification defines a minimal one-variable transition system with state variable x. The initial state sets x to the value of Get, and the next-state action sets x' to the value of Get2; both helper operators are defined as FALSE in this module. The temporal specification is Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<x>>, and the property Prop asserts that eventually the system reaches a suffix in which Print(x, x = TRUE) /\ TLCGet("diameter") > 0 always holds; the file also demonstrates use of TLC-specific operators in a temporal property.
